# Learning procedures reconstructed through actual performance

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`learned-procedure-transmission` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F09 · [record](learned-procedure-transmission.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> In the declared construction, every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network and procedure bit, builds as many successors as capacity allows and conserves material and support, so whole performance can alter reconstruction of the procedure that governs internal change.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. An exposure of the declared construction runs exactly when some formation is active and the source covers every active formation's demand on every task. (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.expose_isSome_iff`)
2. Every exposure keeps the apparatus, writes the network its run leaves and marks the state tested. (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.exposed_kit`)
3. A reconstruction runs exactly when the state is tested and the precursor and support build at least one successor. (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.reconstruct_isSome_iff`)
4. Every reconstruction builds its successors, untested, from the transfer's inherited record and procedure bit. (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.reconstruct_inherits`)
5. The law of transmission: every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network the exposure left and the procedure bit the exposed formation had, builds as many successors as the capacity allows, and conserves material and support. (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.cycle_transmits`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.exposed_accounts`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.reconstructed_accounts`)
6. Under the declared task, support and construction laws, two encounters form a retained network from zero; actual subsequent responses supply computed reconstruction of its matrix and operative updater bit, and reconstructed successors use them; the constructed history is an instance of the law of transmission. (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.actual_acquisition_prefix`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.actual_parent_history`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.actual_reconstruction`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.actual_successor_exposure`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.reconstructed_record_enters_use`, `LearnedProcedureTransmission.history_transmits`)
7. The connected history preserves material and support without resetting failed acquisition. (`LearnedProcedureTransmission.complete_formation_transmission_use`)
8. The capacity is the longest lineage one shared pool releases: reading a successor’s thirteen precursor units as a word of one kind of token, the precursor held as the pool and its twenty support units as drawn at release, n successors are released in turn exactly when n is within the capacity, so a reconstruction builds exactly the longest lineage released (an instance of Copying.lineage_all_iff). (`Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.lineage_released_iff`, `Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.reconstruction_builds_longest_lineage`)
9. Every course of exposures and reconstructions conserves material and support, not one cycle only (an instance of Stock.trace_balance with nothing drawn or replenished). (`Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.material_balanced`, `Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.support_balanced`, `Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.course_conserves`)
10. Faithful reconstruction raises and lowers nothing, so the successors’ total of the procedure bit is the families’ bits weighted by their successor counts, each its capacity (the counting form of Price’s equation); in the history two of three successors carry the responsive procedure where one of two parents did. (`Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.faithful_selects`, `Becoming.TransmissionCorrespondence.history_selects`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Initial hardware, two updating procedures, three-coordinate tanh response and selected-update laws, affine channels and task encounters are supplied.
- One finite source opportunity per task converts to available support exactly on actual success. Reconstruction consumes thirteen precursor and twenty support units, including the ten-unit apparatus build; these are local recipes, not universal physical requirements or source replenishment.
- Exact real-valued matrix copying, source-associated reconstruction, freshly acquired calibration and homogeneous families with separate matched stocks remain idealized premises. The reconstruction recipe itself does not evolve here.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- One finite conditional composition, not a mixed-population invasion model, origin of all learning rules, ecological replenishment, universal generative convergence or complete cognition.
- Absolute continuation, relative representation and shared renewal remain distinct; relative-frequency increase is not required for every generative contribution.
- Conventional models with the same relations keep equal explanatory standing.
- **Counterexample:** Procedure conversion or record erasure preserves offspring count while altering later use. C-only tasks equalize returns; limited precursor equalizes reconstruction counts. Support/source shortages block stages. The changed-channel failure uses a separately declared impaired entrance, not the main successor history. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/evolution-connectionism/LearnedProcedureTransmission.lean)

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

The unchanged checker passed with Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and pinned Mathlib on the source with the general laws (run 20261013T211356.378776Z, its frozen receipt bound): LearnedProcedureTransmission 37 theorems / 57 declaration audits, 308 audits in total, standard logical dependencies only (propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound in the new declarations). The author and an independent reviewer had each freshly compiled the first 30 theorems. Primary-source assessment and independent conceptual review are separate from proof; no new empirical rerun.

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

For a stronger renewal claim, replace the supplied performance-to-support correspondence with an identified renewing activity and trace reconstruction under changed conditions.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Consequences of one organized activity affect reconstruction of its operative components; no independent reward is assigned to each component. The network and updater bit are inherited while channel references are reacquired. Gradients, institutional evaluation and biological reproduction are separate implementations of consequential change, not identical algorithms. Actual task success is not identified with wider generative good.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **interpretive**: [encounter-selection-and-revision](encounter-selection-and-revision.md). Reuses the distinction between acquired information, selection of further encounters and actual use. This new connectionist history is not a formal import of the encounter-choice model.
- **formal-reuse**: [inherited-structural-copying](inherited-structural-copying.md). Reuses Becoming.Copying.lineage_all_iff: the capacity is the longest lineage one shared pool and its support release (TransmissionCorrespondence.lineage_released_iff).
- **formal-reuse**: [evolution-on-descent](evolution-on-descent.md). Reuses the counting form of Becoming.price: faithful reconstruction raises and lowers nothing, so the successors’ total of the procedure bit is the families’ bits weighted by their capacities (TransmissionCorrespondence.faithful_selects).
- related, not a proved adapter: [joint-practice-forms-continuation](joint-practice-forms-continuation.md). A different checked implementation connects joint practice to later participation. Its institutional authorization law is not interchangeable with this reconstruction law.
- related, not a proved adapter: [historical-source-binding](historical-source-binding.md). Retains the distinct cognitive-content and historical-applicability connection; successful reconstruction alone does not establish semantic or temporal warrant.

<a id="history--沿革"></a>
### History

- 9 October 2026: Ren explicitly requested completion and authorized delegation. The new composition reuses calibrated updating, adds an actual zero-matrix acquisition prefix after review, and connects performance to reconstruction and successor use. One result identity; declaration counts are not separate discoveries.
- 14 October 2026, general law (general-laws plan, stream L2, assigned by the integrating session; AI-authored, Claude Opus 5.5): the audit found that the positive point rested only on the constructed history. Laws for every exposure and reconstruction are added (expose_isSome_iff, exposed_kit, reconstruct_isSome_iff, reconstruct_inherits, reconstruct_after_exposure_iff, cycle_transmits), reusing exposed_accounts and reconstructed_accounts for the conservation of material and support; the constructed history is an instance (history_transmits). On 14 October 2026 the same checker, unchanged, passed again on the source with the general laws (run 20261013T211356.378776Z; a wrapper lengthened its fixed 300-second per-command timeout because the machine was heavily loaded): LearnedProcedureTransmission 37 theorems / 57 declaration audits, 308 audits in total, the seven new declarations with only the standard dependencies propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
